description: This file defines a generic interface 'ICatalogLookupDataService' for asynchronously fetching a list of lookup data models in a Blazor WebAssembly project.

classes.name: ICatalogLookupDataService
classes.description: A generic interface for retrieving a list of lookup data asynchronously. It constrains 'TLookupData' to types derived from 'LookupData'.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns a task that, when awaited, provides a list of lookup data items of type 'TLookupData'.
